ctaHeading: Hillside's carpenters are ready — let's build your project.
aboutText: Hillside Carpentry Co has been crafting quality woodwork across Hillside and Melbourne's north-west for over 15 years. From kitchen renovations to custom cabinetry and outdoor decks, our licensed carpenters deliver results that stand the test of time. We are a proudly local, family-run business committed to getting every detail right for homeowners and businesses throughout the region.
servicesText: From kitchen fit-outs and custom cabinetry to decking, framing and full-scale renovations, Hillside Carpentry Co delivers precision workmanship for residential and commercial clients across Hillside and the western suburbs.

services.title: Kitchen Renovations
services.desc: Complete kitchen transformations with custom cabinetry, benchtops and storage solutions tailored to your Hillside home.

services.title: Custom Cabinetry & Joinery
services.desc: Bespoke wardrobes, shelving and built-in furniture designed and crafted by experienced local carpenters.

services.title: Decking & Outdoor Structures
services.desc: Timber and composite decks, pergolas and outdoor entertaining areas built to withstand Melbourne's climate.

services.title: Home Renovations
services.desc: Full-scale renovations including wall framing, ceiling work and internal fit-outs for houses across Hillside.

services.title: Commercial Fit-Outs
services.desc: Shop fittings, office cabinetry and commercial carpentry projects completed on time and on budget.

services.title: Repairs & Maintenance
services.desc: Door repairs, window frames, skirting boards and general carpentry maintenance for Hillside properties.

blogSubheading: Expert advice from Hillside Carpentry Co

reviews.text: Hillside Carpentry Co completely transformed our kitchen with beautiful custom cabinetry. The team was professional, punctual and the craftsmanship is outstanding. We highly recommend them to anyone in Hillside needing quality carpentry work.
reviews.name: Jason Mitchell

reviews.text: We hired them to build a large timber deck and pergola at our Taylors Lakes property. The finished product exceeded our expectations and the whole process was smooth from start to finish. Excellent tradies.
reviews.name: Sarah Coleman

reviews.text: Outstanding commercial fit-out work for our shop in Sunbury. They finished on time, on budget and the attention to detail in the cabinetry was impressive. Would not hesitate to use Hillside Carpentry Co again.
reviews.name: David Nguyen
